parsed.rationale: The second participating record resides at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app path. Per the restraint rules, any record under Examples/ or SampleApp/ triggers sample-app-mirror no-action regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The duplication of MetricRow.body in the sample app is almost certainly intentional: the WallpaperSampleApp needs a self-contained DebugHUD for demonstration purposes and should not be coupled to the production DebugPanel package. Lifting the shared implementation into DebugPanel and making the sample app depend on it would entangle a demonstration target with a production framework boundary.
